main_measure.name: OLS slope of coin-demeaned forward 14-bar return on forecast (pooled, non-overlapping grid, non-zero forecast)
main_measure.threshold: confirm: slope > 0 with t >= 2 and timing gain > 0; reject: slope < 0 with t <= -2; at least 100 cases

supporting_check.name: book timing gain before costs (mean daily book return minus position x coin mean daily return)

decided_by: The slope's t lies between -2 and 2.
reading: The coin's mean 14-bar return is the mean over all its non-overlapping grid returns in all windows (any forecast), the regression is OLS with an intercept on the raw forecast, and the book's daily return is the change of postRebalance_total_value per coin averaged across coins per day, with the market part as the previous day's position times the coin's mean daily close return.
